method_evidence.claim: Audio-Omni is the first framework to unify understanding, generation, and editing across all general sound, music, and speech domains.
method_evidence.anchor: we propose Audio-Omni, the first framework to unify understanding, generation, and editing across all general sound, music, and speech domains.

method_evidence.claim: The generative backbone is built upon Rectified Flow.
method_evidence.anchor: Our generative backbone is built upon the framework of Rectified Flow [Liu et al. 2022]

method_evidence.claim: Rectified Flow models a straight-line trajectory between noise and data via an ODE with constant velocity.
method_evidence.anchor: Rectified Flow simplifies the generation process by modeling a straight-line trajectory between noise and data... via a simple ordinary differential equation (ODE) with a constant velocity field v = x_1 - x_0.

experiment_evidence.claim: AudioEdit dataset comprises over 1M samples covering add, remove, extract, and style transfer tasks.
Real data branch retains ~50K pairs after CLAP filtering from ~347K VAD-filtered pairs.

formula_evidence.name: Rectified Flow ODE
formula_evidence.latex: \frac { d \mathbf { x } _ { t } } { d t } = \mathbf { v }
formula_evidence.meaning: ODE defining the constant velocity trajectory from noise to data.

formula_evidence.name: Linear interpolation solution
formula_evidence.latex: \mathbf { x } _ { t } = ( 1 - t ) \mathbf { x } _ { 0 } + t \mathbf { x } _ { 1 }
formula_evidence.meaning: Solution at time t along the linear path between data x_0 and noise x_1.
